zzpiuo:250: The article's claim that "token prices drop roughly 10x every 18 months" is an undervalued macro variable. This declining curve has two key implications for AI transformation strategy: first, it lowers the cost of installing a brand-new operating model inside companies that haven't yet built one, making the "someone else will build it for you" path cheaper and more attractive; second, it changes the ROI calculation—if tokens become cheaper and better, continuous employee retraining becomes unnecessary, meaning the upfront costs of AI investment can be amortized across a longer return period. Together, these two implications create a positive feedback loop that accelerates transformation: cheaper → faster adoption → wider gap → harder for non-adopters to catch up.
